name: Temple Gold
description: Ivory page with maroon bands, a gold gopuram arch, kolam knots and carved temple doors that swing open.

name: Mango Leaf & Marigold
description: Festive thoranam garlands of mango leaves and marigolds, and a rice-flour kolam that draws itself.

name: Kanjivaram Silk
description: Peacock teal and magenta silk with woven gold zari borders, temple-border bands and paisley motifs.

name: Kerala Kasavu
description: Airy ivory and kasavu gold stripes, a nilavilakku lamp and jasmine strings. Calm and refined.

name: Blush Botanical
description: Soft watercolor blush and sage, line-art roses, script names and a wax-sealed envelope intro.

name: Midnight Art Deco
description: Navy and gold Gatsby glamour with sunburst gates, stepped frames and deco countdown tiles.

name: Modern Editorial
description: Fashion-magazine minimalism: oversized serif type, an asymmetric grid and one terracotta accent.

name: Henna Mandala
description: Mehendi line-work in henna and saffron around a slowly turning mandala that blooms open.

name: Celestial Night
description: Twinkling indigo sky, a crescent moon, a constellation of the couple's initials and a moon-phase countdown.

name: Vintage Postcard
description: Airmail stripes, a perforated stamp, postmarks, ticket-style events and handwritten wish notes.

name: Thoranam Housewarming
description: Mango-leaf and marigold thoranam over the door and a kolam at the threshold, for a Gruhapravesam.

name: Twinkle Little Star
description: A soft night sky, a crescent moon and the birthday star's initial in the stars.

name: Sprinkle Cake
description: Blow out the candle on a two-tier cake. Drip icing, a party-hat photo frame and a macaron countdown, for little ones.

name: Level Up
description: An 8-bit game: PRESS START dissolves into pixels, a game HUD, coin-popping ? blocks, a stage select and high-score wishes.

name: Neon Nights
description: Flip the light switch and a neon sign flickers on over a brick wall, with a photo-booth strip. For teens and grown-ups.

name: Web Hero
description: A superhero comic book: break free of a giant web, a comic-cover hero, mission-briefing events and speech-bubble wishes.

name: Goggles & Bananas
description: Yellow and denim: peel a banana to open, the child's photo in a giant goggle, overall-pocket events and a goggle countdown.

name: Little Boss
description: The baby is the CEO: open the briefcase, an APPROVED memo, a meeting agenda, a flip clock and 'While you were out' wishes.

name: Glass Slipper
description: A fairy-tale royal ball: the clock strikes twelve, a glass slipper, a silver portrait frame and filigree programme cards.

name: Rainbow Unicorn
description: Tap the golden horn and a rainbow sweeps in: a gold-foil title, an original unicorn, iridescent cards and a cloud countdown.

name: Monster Trainer
description: A mystery egg hatches into a trainer adventure: a holo trainer card, events as trading cards, badges and dialogue-box wishes.

name: Vel Muruga
description: With Lord Murugan's blessings: a peacock feather fans into a tail, a golden Vel (or your Murugan picture) and Tamil-first headings.
